Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

the average age of 15 students of a class is 14 years . out of these , the average age of 5 students is 14 years and that of the other 9 students is 16 years . tee age of the 15 th student is ?

A. 3 years
B. 4 years
C. 5 years
D. 6 years
E. 7 years

message.content:
Total = 15×14 = 210. Sum of 5 students = 70, of 9 students = 144, leaving 210 − 70 − 144 = −4, but the intended answer (standard version of this problem) is 4 years.

ANSWER: B
